item.title: Protesters unveil melting Ron DeSantis statue to signify his inaction on climate crisis
item.description: Florida governor has consistently opposed any legislation to curb planet-heating emissions, calling it a ‘radical climate agenda’ A life-sized statue of Ron DeSantis, the Florida governor, was unveiled and promptly began melting in front of an audience in Tallahassee in a symbolic protest at his rejection of action on the climate crisis. The silvery statue, revealed to an audience of onlookers last week, melted away to show a skull under DeSantis’ face. The structure was cast from solid gallium, a metal that melts at 85.6F (29.8C), which is below summertime high temperatures frequently… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: Many data centers are located where water resources are limited
item.description: One-quarter of the world's data centers are located in areas where water demand exceeds supply for at least one month each year, according to a new global analysis. item.title: Brazilian court orders Meta to prove Lula and Bolsonaro get equal treatment
item.description: Brazil’s top electoral court has given Meta 24 hours to prove it is treating campaign content from incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro equally on its online platforms, threatening a daily fine for noncompliance. The ruling follows allegations from Lula's campaign that the social media giant is suppressing Lula’s campaign content ahead of Sunday’s closely contested presidential runoff.
